tier: Rack / Nett (no separate named STO tier on this document — Nett is Elewana's contracted rate to Sunworld, computed as Rack x 0.60 on every checked cell, i.e. an implied ~40% discount)

rates.unit: per person per night unless noted

mandatoryFees.note: From EC-2026-Rates-40.pdf page 19 (Kenya Applicable Fees section). Unlike Soroi properties, child fee bracket here is 3-17, not 5-11.

childPolicy.note: Elewana portfolio-wide policy (EC-2026-Rates-40.pdf page 22) — materially different from Soroi's 50%-of-adult rule for ages 5-11. FLAG this on any quote using Tortilis alongside Soroi properties.

inclusionsNote.gamePackageOnly: Scheduled/shared game drives twice daily, airstrip transfer to/from Amboseli (per vehicle) included on Game Package; both cost extra on Full Board (activities $220/$187 rack/nett, airstrip transfer $120/$102 rack/nett).
inclusionsNote.circuitDiscount: 6+ nights 5%, 9+ nights 10%, 12+ nights 15% (1 Jul-31 Oct / 20 Dec-3 Jan window); different bands apply in the other season window — see page 23 of source.
